description: This file contains mock class definitions for rbus interface used in testing. It defines an abstract interface 'rbusInterface' with virtual methods representing rbus functions, and a mock class 'rbusMock' deriving from it, with MOCK_METHOD macros for mocking behavior in unit tests.

classes.name: rbusInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface providing virtual methods for rbus operations, intended for mocking and testing.

classes.name: rbusMock
classes.description: Mock implementation of rbusInterface, using gmock macros to facilitate unit testing of code that interacts with rbus.

methods.name: rbus_open
methods.description: Opens an rbus handle with a given name.

methods.name: rbus_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key from rbus.

methods.name: rbusValue_ToString
methods.description: Converts rbusValue to a string representation.

methods.name: rbusValue_SetString
methods.description: Sets a string value into an rbusValue.

methods.name: rbusValue_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from an rbusValue.

methods.name: rbusObject_SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in an rbus object.

methods.name: rbusObject_GetValue
methods.description: Gets a value from an rbus object.

methods.name: rbusValue_SetInt32
methods.description: Sets an int32 value into an rbusValue.

methods.name: rbusError_ToString
methods.description: Converts an rbusError to a string.

methods.name: rbusMethodCaller
methods.description: Calls a method, providing parameters and capturing output.
